name: Ultralight Wide White Oak Slats, Beige Felt
summary: White oak real-wood veneer laminated directly onto 9 mm recycled beige acoustic felt, with no MDF or other rigid core.

texture.note: Manufacturer spec overrides photo estimates: three 97 mm (3.8189 in) faces on 100 mm (3.9370 in) pitches per 300 mm panel, with 3 mm (0.1181 in) wide, 1.5 mm deep 90-degree V reveals and 9 mm veneer-on-felt total depth; colors follow main.jpg pale white oak and beige felt. Tile covers three pitches by 500 mm vertically; the spec permits broad curves but explicitly rules out wrapping columns, and the 3000 mm panel is 48 mm short of a true 10 ft wall.
